conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
conn.autocommit = True
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute("DELETE FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings")
cur.executemany(
    '''
    INSERT INTO actimize_screening_type_mappings
      ("Search_Definition_ID", is_active, created_at, updated_at, search_definition_name, screening_type_name, display_order)
    VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
    ''',
    rows,
)

cur.execute(
    '''
    SELECT "Search_Definition_ID", is_active, created_at, updated_at, search_definition_name, screening_type_name, display_order
    FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings
    ORDER BY display_order
    '''
)
out = [list(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
print("LOAD_OK", json.dumps({"row_count": len(out), "rows": out}, ensure_ascii=False))

cur.close()
conn.close()
